test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**However**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence contrasts the progress made in literacy rates with the continuing challenge of illiteracy among adults.
 
• The word "**However**" is used to introduce a contrast or opposing idea. (हालाँकि)
 
• It fits perfectly to highlight that despite progress, a significant number of people remain illiterate.
 
• Other options do not fit the context:
 
 
• **Whenever** (जब भी): Indicates time, not contrast.
 
• **Otherwise** (अन्यथा): Indicates consequence, not suitable here.
 
• **Thus** (इस प्रकार): Indicates result or conclusion, not contrast.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Updated Passage (till blank 4): *Worldwide illiteracy rates have **consistently**__ declined in the last few decades. One of the major reasons for this decline is the sharp increase in literacy rates __**among**__ young women, which is a result of specific __**campaigns**__ designed to increase educational opportunities for girls. __**However**__, there are still an estimated 771 million illiterate adults in the world...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Whenever** – Used to indicate time or condition.

 **Example:** You can visit me whenever you like.
 
• **Otherwise** – Indicates consequence or alternative.

 **Example:** Hurry up, otherwise we’ll be late.
 
• **Thus** – Used to show result or inference.

 **Example:** He was the only candidate left, thus he was selected.
